text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The load-bearing claim here is 'D2: churn via ONE git blame --line-porcelain pass per file', and it is verified: there is exactly one _git blame call in this module, inside a for-path loop, so one subprocess per file and no per-entity blame. The section dividers (docstrings / git) still label the sections they precede, and the run() stats dict still reports the four counters those sections fill.
